# The Style Workshop
> Beautifully Considered Spaces

The Style Workshop is a boutique residential interior design studio founded and directed by Emily Webster. Based in Mosman on Sydney's Lower North Shore, the studio has been creating considered, liveable interiors since 2009 across Sydney's Lower North Shore, Northern Beaches, Eastern Suburbs, Inner West, and rural New South Wales.

## About Emily Webster
Emily Webster is the principal interior designer and founder of The Style Workshop. With 17+ years of experience and 80+ projects completed, she specialises in considered residential interiors, from curated room refreshes to full renovations. Emily works across Sydney's most sought-after neighbourhoods including Mosman, Cremorne, Neutral Bay, Cammeray, North Sydney, Crows Nest, Kirribilli, Woollahra, Paddington, Double Bay, Balmain, Manly, and the wider Northern Beaches.

## Services
- **The Initial Consultation**: $895 incl. GST. A 90-minute in-home consultation covering layout and spatial planning advice, open Q&A, and written recommendations with visual reference delivered within 3 business days. Credited in full toward the Signature Styling Experience or The Tailored Programme if signed within 30 days.
- **The Design Edit**: $2,800 incl. GST. A fully resolved design for one room: concept direction, lighting recommendations, colour palette and material selections, and a curated shopping edit, ready for the client to execute.
- **The Signature Styling Experience**: $4,950 incl. GST. The featured full-service package, from concept through to delivery, with access to trade-only showrooms and exclusive one-of-a-kind pieces.
- **The Tailored Programme**: from $7,950 incl. GST. Designed entirely around the client's brief and scaled to the size of the project. Begins with a complimentary discovery call.

Additional services (Finishing Layer, Furniture Selection, Sourcing, Artwork, Lighting, Additional Rooms) are quoted per project.

Design hourly rate: $275/hr incl. GST. Travel beyond 30 minutes each way: $137/hr. Procurement margin: 20% on trades/items, always disclosed upfront. All prices include GST.

## Process
1. Discovery: site visit, client brief, establishing direction.
2. Concept Design: mood, colour, material and spatial concept.
3. Refinement: feedback, adjustments, finalisation.
4. Delivery & Support: procurement coordination, installation and styling.
